metric.description: Table 1 behavioral regression uses Pearson r, sum((y-y_mean)*(prediction-prediction_mean))/sqrt(sum((y-y_mean)^2)*sum((prediction-prediction_mean)^2)). Undefined constant-series values cannot be replaced by a success score. Original neural metrics remain separately required; source classification metrics are required only if the classification result or control is authenticated as indispensable to the named VisNav primary.

aggregation.description: The released inference plot uses first 200 rows per behavior mode; publication support and pooling/seed aggregation are not authenticated. Do not substitute full-support r or average speed and gaze.

minimum_effect.rationale: For behavioral Pearson endpoints, justify any meaningful task-specific increase in correlation on each authenticated original result’s support after resolving the paper version and calibration. Neither a behavioral correlation margin nor an observed speed gain establishes full-family improvement. No effect threshold or family-level decision rule is supplied; these remain unresolved.

uncertainty.method: Specify paired temporal dependence-aware uncertainty and seed replication after recovering original recording identities and support; do not treat adjacent windows or neurons as independent subjects.
